title: A Fractional Logistic-Type Elliptic Problem with Global Interactions: Existence, Local Uniqueness, and the Fractional-to-Local Limit
summary: We study a fractional logistic-type elliptic problem on a bounded domain with homogeneous exterior conditions and linear and nonlinear integral interactions. The interaction kernels may be nonsymmetric and sign-changing, so the problem need not admit a variational formulation. In the symmetric competitive regime, coercivity yields a weak solution by global minimization. For arbitrary fixed values of the interaction parameter, explicit smallness conditions allow us to apply Schauder's fixed-point theorem without symmetry or sign restrictions on the kernels.
